text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, Jan 7 - Chittagong - 20 Vessels in port of which 3 containers, 3 general cargo, 2 fertiliser, 1 tanker, 5 foodgrain, 1 salt, 2 cement clinker, 3 others. 42 Vessels due by 14/1 of which 15 containers, 5 general cargo, 2 export loaders, two 48 hours, 3 car carriers, 4 cement, 1 scrap, 3 fertiliser, 2 survey vessels, 3 rapeseed, 1 bitumen, 1 tanker. No berthing delays.

INDIA, Jan 7 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 2-3 days, bulk vessels 12-14 days, general cargo 2-3 days. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 15 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering, 1 under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 18 Vessels due (3 coking coal, 4 product tankers, 3 containers, 1 rbd palmoil, 1 mtbe methanol, 1 lash, 2 rock phosphate, 2 steel billets, 1 crude tanker). 7 Vessels loading at berth, 14 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 2 bunkering.

Cochin - 13 Vessels due, up to 1 days delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Repairs/drydock - 1 Small fishing vessel, 2 small crafts, 1 general cargo. Mormugao - Eight ore vessels due, 4-5 days delay expected, 1 oil due, 1 blackfeed stock due, 1 caustic soda due. 2 Vessels loading t berth, 2 loading at anchorage, 5 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Kandla - Ten vessels due. Delays expected, rice/general cargo, granite blocks 10-12 days, teus 2-3 days, ckd 1-2 days. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 4 discharging at ber

Mangalore - Eight vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected. 6 Vessels loading/discharging at berth/,4 vessels awaiting berth, 1 vessel arrested. Madras - 29 Vessels due by 13/1 of which 8 general cargo, 2 edible oil, 3 coal, 8 containers, 2 pax, 3 granite blocks, 1 lube oil, 1 fertiliser, 1 chemicals. Delays expected, coal/coke 4-5 days, fertiliser 3-4 days, scrap 5-6 days, others 3-4 days, no days for containers/iron ore. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 11 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 under repair. Jawaharlal Nehru - One fertiliser/raw material vessel due, no delays expected. 3 Tankers/iron ore due, 2 vessels discharging at berth,

Paradip - Vessels due, 3 coal, 1 chrome, 2 oil, 2 chemical/gas. 2 Days delay expected for oil. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Tuticorin - Five vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Visakhapatnam - 17 Vessels due. Delays expected, 7-8 days for steel plates, wire coils, granite blocks, timber logs, magnesite, rock phosphate, up to 1 day for alumina powder, containers, phosphic acid, 10-12 days for coking coal, 3-4 days for sunflower, 5-6 days for general cargo. 10 Vessels loading

MALAYSIA, Jan 8 - Port Kelang - North/south port - Container/ro/ro berth - 6 Vessels alongside, 10 waiting, 1 day waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 4 waiting, 5 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 3 Vessels alongside, 1 berthed, vessels waiting, 2 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels alongside, 8 waiting, 1 days waiting time. West port - Container/ro/ro berth - 1 Vessel alongside. Bulk cement terminal - 1 Vessel alongside, 2 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 6 Vessels alongside, 1 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - No vessels.

PAKISTAN, Jan 6 - Karachi - Three vessels due, up to 24 hours delay expected. 4 Vessels loading rice at berth, 6 containers loading and discharging at berth, 12 vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, logs, urea, dap, phosphate, fuel oil and palm oil). 3 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load rice, 15 waiting at anchorage to discharge (general cargo, containers, fertiliser, tankers, gas oil and hsd). 3
PHILIPPINES, Jan 6 - Manila - South harbour - 12 Vessels discharging at pier berth, 5 discharging at anchorage, 1 waiting at outside anchorage to discharge, 1 other vessel.

SIERRA LEONE, Jan 6 - Freetown - Vessels due, 2 container dischargers, 1 container/vehicles discharger, 1 vehicle carrier, no delays expected. Discharging/loading at berth, 1 rice discharger, 1 aid cargo discharger, 1 cargo vessel anchored. Vessels must be in/out of port before 1900 hours.

SOUTH KOREA, Jan 7 - Inchon - 74 Vessels in port (46 berthed, 28 anchored) of which 13 general cargo, 5 each steel, corn, 4 container vessels, 3 each logs, cars, 2 each plywood, pig iron, 1 each steel billets, ingots, cotton seed meal, wheat blending pellets, pulp, copra, salt, wheat, steel plates. Anchored, 6 corn, 3 cars, 2 each logs, containers, steel, coils, pig iron, 1 each soybean, wheat, h-beam, ingots, molasses, wheat blending pellets, oak leaves, pulp, cotton seed meal, approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Busan - 162 Vessels in port (46 berthed, 116 anchored including 59 laid up) of which 33 general cargo, 7 containers, 3 each scrap, coal. 57 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 2 d

Pohang - 16 Vessels in port (10 berthed, 6 anchored) of which discharging, 1 iron ore, pipes, billets, coils, scrap. 5 Vessels loading steel. 6 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay pected. Ulsan - 20 Vessels in port (17 berthed, 3 anchored) of which discharging, 3 woodchips, 2 chemicals, 1 each coke, cement, feed meal, butadiene, sugar, tallow, corn, zinc concentrates. Vessels loading, 3 chemicals, 1 steel pipes, 3 vessels awaiting berth with approx. 2-3 days delay expected. Masan - 7 Vessels berthed of which discharging, 2 logs, 1 each bananas, silica sand, steel scrap. Loading, 1 cars, 1 coaches, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, Jan 7 - Colombo - Nine container vessels due, 2-3 days delay for conventional vessels. 11 Vessels loading at berth of which 2 essential services, 7 containers, 2 general cargo. 21 Vessels discharging at berth of which 1 bagged sugar, 14 containers, 1 bulk lpg, 2 steel, 1 ro/ro, 2 bagged rice. 10 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 5 containers (for discharging/loading), 1 bagged rice, 1 bagged cement, 2 bulk cement, 1 general cargo. 2 Vessels bunkering, 3 in drydock, 1 awaiting orders.
Galle - One vessel discharging at berth.
Trincomalee - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth.

TAIWAN, Jan 4 - Keelung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain, coal 6 days, steel 3 days, iron ore 2 days. Kaohsiung - Two vessels anchored. 1 Day berthing delay for grain, iron/coal (csc berth, coal/scrap (public berth) and steel. Taichung - Five vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain, steel 1-2 days, iron ore, coal, scrap, others 1 day.
